allowed_decisions: accepting a new completion date on Nathan's behalf

collect.question: Open by referencing the open item from the background: what it is, when it was promised, and by whom.
Ask for the current status in specific terms: done, in progress with a stage, or blocked with a reason.
If it is not complete, ask for the new completion date and exactly what will happen by then.
Repeat the status and the new commitment back and ask them to confirm.

end_conditions: The person cannot access the item and names who can and how to reach them.
goal: Check the current status of an open item from Nathan's records (see the background in this brief — open commitments are listed first), get a concrete updated state and a new commitment with a date if the item is not complete.
loop_in_triggers: They dispute that the original commitment was ever made and the conversation stalls.
They ask for any personal identifier or credential.
They will only speak to Nathan himself.
name: follow_up_status
success_conditions: A specific current status was given.
Either the item is confirmed complete, or a new dated commitment replaced the old one.
title: Follow-up / status check
